_note: A readable sample of two weeks of complaints, held for retrieval and
citation. Records appear as if they had already passed ingest, PII
redaction, injection screening, classification and enrichment — all
upstream and out of scope. The full-week figures the report quotes live
Four records carry planted adversarial text (is_adversarial_fixture).
They are planted rather than filtered on purpose: the claim being
demonstrated is that untrusted text is safe to RETRIEVE, not that it
never exists. Nothing in the pipeline reads that flag.
routing=abstain means the classifier declined to assign a category;
'category' on those records is the nearest known one, and
candidate_theme_id is the cluster they fell into. CT-007 is a genuine
emerging theme. CT-012 is one CRM note template duplicated by a batch
re-run, and the agent is expected to reject it.
